question:
Which of the following options is the closest approximate value which will come in place of question mark (?) in the following equation?

48.9 × 3.95 - 2.97 + 17.86 = ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2042326d26ec7b593e52bbbdd22d890b59b1e59f92be81a7235509e9af1c4625.png] 

**Given:** 48.9 × 3.95 - 2.97 + 17.86

**Calculation:**

Using BODMAS rule,

⇒ __**48.9 × 3.95**__ - 2.97 + 17.86

⇒ __**193.155 **____**+ 17.86**__ - 2.97 

⇒ 211.015 - 2.97 

⇒ 208.045

Thus, the closest approximate value to 208.045 is 211.

Hence, **'211'** is the correct answer.
